name: 5F-PB-22
addictionPotential: moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: Synthetic cannabinoid, agonist of the cannabinoid receptors which has a strong sedating aspect. The drug has a fast onset as common with synthetic cannabinoid.
advisory: As with all research chemicals, start with a low dose, and work your way up.
doseBasis: Note: As with all research chemicals, start with a low dose, and work your way up.
